{{Quote|I am General Lok Durd of the Separatist Alliance. ''[&hellip;]'' You are now under the ''protection'' of the Separatist Alliance. I congratulate you on your good fortune.|Lok Durd to Tee Watt Kaa|audio=LokDurd1.flac|<ref name="DOP">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref>}}
'''Lok Durd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] weapons developer and [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] who served in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the war, he created an experimental [[Defoliator/Legends|defoliator]]&mdash;an [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] weapon that could theoretically wipe out any organic matter while leaving machinery unharmed. Durd chose to test his weapon on the isolated [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]], as it was home to a [[Lurmen village|colony]] of pacifist [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]]. After landing on the planet and setting up a base camp, Durd initially tested the defoliator on a pair of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Following the experiment's success, he moved to [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|attack]] the Lurmen in order to impress [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. However, Durd was interrupted by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], who had crash-landed on Maridun prior to Durd's arrival. Using [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] that they had captured from Durd's base camp, the Jedi were able to block the defoliator ray targeted at the colony with a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. Following a brief battle, Durd and his assistant, [[Pune Zignat/Legends|Pune Zignat]], was captured by the Jedi and subsequently taken into [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody.

==Biography==
===Early career===
====The defoliator====
{{Quote|We test a new weapon, of my own design, which is capable of catastrophic destruction. A weapon which will destroy organic matter, but leave machines unharmed.|Lok Durd, on the defoliator|audio=LokDurd2.flac|<ref name="DOP" />}}
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] Lok Durd hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Complete Season One" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he had become a [[General/Legends|general]] and weapons designer for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="DOP" /> Durd was assisted in his research by his chief weapons technician, the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Pune Zignat/Legends|Pune Zignat]], whose careful design work and planning had much to do with making Durd a success.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> During the war, Durd developed a [[Defoliator/Legends|defoliator]], an enhanced [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] weapon that was capable of destroying living matter while leaving inorganic material unharmed, in the hopes that it would enable him to rise up through the ranks of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. Because the Confederate [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] [[Army/Legends|Army]] was largely made up of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], the defoliator's specific targeting of enemy organics made it ideal for the Confederacy. The defoliator was mounted on a modified [[Heavy Artillery Gun|heavy artillery gun]] and, when loaded, fired a large [[Missile/Legends|missile]] that created a large, fiery shock wave upon detonation. However, the wave could be blocked by a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]].<ref name="DOP" />

As the defoliator proved to be very expensive and costly, it needed to be tested before [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the Confederacy, would back any further development. Durd began to seek out a lush planet with a primitive culture that he could safely subject to experimentation.<ref name="DB" /> After trekking the [[Star/Legends|stars]],<ref name="DOP Decoded">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace|d=y}}</ref> Durd discovered the remote world of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]], home to a small, peaceful [[Lurmen village|Lurmen colony]]. Because Durd believed that the pacifist [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] would not defend themselves, he deemed Maridun to be the perfect testing site for the defoliator. Landing planetside on Maridun with the defoliator and several [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of battle droids, Durd and his forces built a small but heavily armed base camp and proceeded to the Lurmen colony so that Durd could "claim" the land for the Separatists. Arriving at the colony aboard a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], Durd and Zignat met with the colony's [[Chief/Legends|leader]], [[Tee Watt Kaa/Legends|Tee Watt Kaa]].<ref name="DOP" /> To avoid causing a panic,<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> Durd lied to Kaa, stating that the colony was now under Separatist "protection"&mdash;hiding his intentions of targeting the Lurmen with the defoliator&mdash;and would remain unharmed as long as it offered no resistance.<ref name="DOP" />

[[File:LokDurddude2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Lok Durd speaks with Count Dooku during the defoliator's first test.]]
With that, Durd moved forward with a squad of his droids to "inspect his new colony." After ordering his droids to ransack the colony and search for Republic contraband, Durd learned that there was no evidence of Republic weapons. Durd then told Kaa that in the future, more periodic searches would be conducted to "maintain security." Remarking that the Lurmen were "smarter than they appeared," Durd returned to the base camp with his droids<ref name="DOP" /> to conduct the defoliator's first field test<ref name="DB" /> and double-check that it would not harm inorganic beings.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> Returning to the Separatist base, Durd prepared for the defoliator's test, stationing his forces just beyond the base's walls so that he could speak to them from above on a perch along the front wall Durd announced the creation of his new weapon to the battle droids, and they cheered. However, when he stated that he required two volunteers, the droids' ranks quickly receded, leaving two very reluctant [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] that Durd "picked" as the volunteers to serve as the defoliator's test subjects.<ref name="DOP" />

While the two battle droids moved into position faraway from the base, Durd opened a [[Hologram/Legends|hololink]] to Count Dooku to show him the tests and their results. After the two droids were a safe distance away from the base camp, Durd ordered the defoliator to be loaded and fired. Another pair of B1 battle droids loaded the defoliator missile, and Zignat prepared to fire the weapon at the two droids. The Aqualish [[Technician/Legends|technician]] then launched the missile; as it landed, it exploded into a raging and expanding inferno. The two battle droids were quickly engulfed by the shockwave, while Durd and the rest of his troops, along with Count Dooku through the hololink, watched from back at the camp. As the smoke generated by the defoliator dissipated, it revealed the two battle droids, slightly smoking but otherwise unharmed and intact, standing in the middle of a desolate wasteland. To Durd, the defoliator appeared to work: the two test subjects were not damaged, and all organic life around them was completely wiped out. Dooku stated that the new weapon was very impressive and that it should be tested on living, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] subjects. At Dooku's behest, Durd promised that he would test the weapon on the Lurmen colony. The Neimoidian general then closed the hololink with Dooku and prepared to travel to the Lurmen colony to test the defoliator, taking three squads of droids with him, as well as three [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]].<ref name="DOP" />

====Battle of Maridun====
{{Quote|There goes my promotion.|Lok Durd, after being captured by Anakin Skywalker|audio=LokDurd4.flac|<ref name="DOP" />}}
{{Main|Defense of Maridun/Legends}}
[[File:Durd_in_command.png|thumb|right|250px|Lok Durd commands his droid forces on Maridun.]]
General Durd and his forces arrived at the colony the next day and set up positions a considerable distance away from it, but close enough so that the village was in range of the defoliator. When one of the droids told Durd that a barricade had been set up, the Neimoidian laughed, thinking it was only the Lurmen trying to protect themselves. However, a glance through a pair of [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]] revealed to him the presence of a small [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] force&mdash;[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], Skywalker's [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]], and Clone [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]. The Jedi and the clones had crash-landed on Maridun before Durd had even arrived, in the wake of the [[Sky Battle of Quell]], and had taken refuge with the Lurmen. The force had also witnessed Durd's test of the defoliator, and took measures to protect their Lurmen allies as a result. Upon seeing the Jedi and the clones, Durd ordered that the defoliator be fired at them.<ref name="DOP" />

The enemy saw that the Separatists were loading the defoliator, and they activated several [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] they had stolen from Durd's camp, and the resultant deflector shield enveloped the colony. As soon as loading was complete on the defoliator, Durd commanded his aide to fire the weapon. The missile landed several meters in front of the deflector shield, and the fiery shockwave began to expand. When the shockwave reached the shield, however, it was unable to break through and was effectively stopped. After the wave had dissipated, the Jedi and clones emerged from behind the pod barricade, preparing for the Separatists' charge. Durd realized he would have to destroy the shields for the defoliator to be effective, and ordered [[Squad One (Lok Durd)|his first squad]], consisting of several B1 and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]], to charge forward and attack.<ref name="DOP" />

The first squad charged across the newly devastated field and engaged the Jedi, but the Republic forces were able to drive them off. Durd and the rest of his forces watched on as the first squad was obliterated. The general then ordered [[Squad Two (Lok Durd)|his second]] and [[Squad Three (Lok Durd)|third squads]] to charge forward, leaving behind just a few battle droids and the three tanks to guard his own position. As the second wave of droids attacked, the Jedi were unable to destroy all of them, and a portion of the Confederate force got past their line. They eventually were able to push through and destroy the enemy shield generators.<ref name="DOP" />

[[File:LokDurddude.png|thumb|left|250px|Lok Durd is captured by Skywalker.]]
Seeing that the shield was down, Durd ordered his droids to reload the defoliator and destroy the village; however, Skywalker was already bearing down on him at a [[Force speed/Legends|rapid speed]]. Durd ordered his tanks to blast the Jedi Knight, but Skywalker was too fast for the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire and managed to evade them. The Jedi destroyed the defoliator along with several of the droids guarding Durd. In the process, a defoliator projectile was dropped by the droids. Durd, afraid that he would be "defoliated" by the projectile rolling toward him, jumped out of his AAT and attempted to run away, but Skywalker [[Telekinesis/Legends|lifted]] him from the ground before the Neimoidian general could run far. Durd's forces were eventually routed by the combined effort of the Republic and Lurmen forces. After the battle, the Jedi prepared to leave the colony with the captured general, and three Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] jumped into the system to pick them up.<ref name="DOP" />

===Late career===
====A new bioweapon====
{{Quote|We're doing great work here, Doctor Fhernan. Great work. And when all is said and done, the galaxy will be deeply, ''deeply'' in our debt. We are on the brink of achieving freedom from the tyranny of the Republic and its raddled Senate. There'll be songs sung about us one day, my dear. ''Songs''. I can hear them now.|Lok Durd to [[Bant'ena Fhernan]]|<ref name="Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
Sometime after the [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|Battle of Maridun]], in [[21 BBY/Legends|21BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Lok Durd managed to escape [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody and return to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]], unbeknownst to most of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] officials and [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] authorities but to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], the latter being the head of [[Senate Security Committee|Republic Security Committee]] and who had that intel as a closed guarded secret. With the attack and annexation of [[Taratos IV]] by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist army]] and the capture of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Bant'ena Fhernan]], [[General/Legends|General]] Durd became in charge of ''“The Project”'' – a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] that was being developed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]], also invaded and captured by the Confederacy.<ref name="Stealth" /> By threatening the loved ones of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Fhernan, Durd forced her to create a [[Damotite bioweapon|damotite-based gaseous chemical]] that liquefied living matter on contact,<ref name="TERC" /> and after the test of the new formula completed, she gave the [[Data crystal/Legends|data crystal]] copy to the general, who went to report to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and started the production of the weapon.<ref name="Stealth" />

On a secret mission to Lanteeb to investigate more about the possible existence of a bioweapon, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] infiltrated Bant’ena’s [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] and Anakin, feeling sympathy for anyone so [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]], promised to free her and her targeted family, though Obi-Wan thought he was overstepping their mandate. With hope that her family and friends could be spared, Fhernan agreed to help the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] by stalling her progress. She also provided them with the names of offworld colleagues capable of developing an [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]] to her project.<ref name="TERC" />  However, because of the rescue of Bant'ena’s [[Parent/Legends|mother]] - [[Mata Fhernan]] - by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Taria Damsin]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], which was informed by an [[Anzat/Legends|Anzati]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] captured by the Jedi on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Lok Durd realized he was deceived by the doctor, especially after discovering that two [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] were missing from their designated location, and several sections of security [[Holorecorder/Legends|recordings]], including footage from the lab, Bant'ena’s room, and a few corridors, were erased. Furious, Durd ordered the [[Death/Legends|death]] of one of her friends and made her watch [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] evidence of the murder, breaking her spirit. Then, after threatening the lives of her nephews and under heavy physical [[Torture/Legends|torture]], Dr. Fhernan ceded and gave in the information about the Jedi, and promised to help the general by luring them into a trap once they made contact with her again. When Obi-Wan and Anakin returned to the laboratory with the intent to rescue Bant'ena, they barely escaped being [[Blaster/Legends|blasted]] by Separatist [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Stealth" /> 

[[File:Masterofneimoidia.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The evil Neimoidian general Lok Durd looms over his cowering captive, scientist Bant'ena Fhernan.]]<ref name="TERC" /> 
Count Dooku, who [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|distress in the Force]], eventually called Lok Durd to inquiry about the progress on ''“The Project”''. For fear of facing the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord’s]] wrath, Durd lied about the real situation on Lanteeb, with no mention of the Jedi nor the hostages who were rescued, and promising to deliver the weapon in four [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. As soon as he regained his composure, the Neimoidian general came up with a plan, and ordered [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Barev]] - a Separatist liaison [[Officer/Legends|officer]] - to start an all-out [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] on the Jedi, as well as demanding the stage-two facility to be prepared for immediate occupation, as he intended to move himself and Dr. Fhernan for security reasons after their main facility was compromised. After several days without success, nonetheless, Colonel Barev requested General Durd to hire a psychic seeker – a [[Drivok]] – as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], who were known for having an excellent reputation on finding people due to their abilities. At last, the Jedi were found by the Drivok, who had its job made easier by the fact that both Obi-Wan and Anakin had to reveal themselves by using the [[The Force/Legends|Force]], in order to save the [[City/Legends|village]] they were hidden in from a [[theta storm]].<ref name="Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>

Ultimately, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was reported by both Bail Organa and Yoda about the secret mission on Lanteeb and how much they knew about it: Lok Durd as the head of the project, the [[Damotite bioweapon]], the kidnapped scientist, the already freed hostages and the scientist they hired to develop an antidote, [[Tryn Netzl]] - all thanks to Anakin and Obi-Wan. When confronted by his enraged [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] about all these events, [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] realized he was conned by the Neimoidian general. Despite the initial irritation of his Master, Sidious ordered Tyranus to keep Durd alive – only with a sharp reminder of his place - and in its due time, to discreetly facilitate his escape from Lanteeb, hiding him somewhere unattainable. General Durd was, in turn, confident on his success. With the last kink in Dr. Fhernan’s formula taken care of, the first shipments of raw [[damotite]] delivered, tested and approved, and his droid workforce slaving without pause to convert the damotite-and-[[Rondium/Legends|rondium]] mixture to pure [[Poison/Legends|poison]], he was at last able to bask in the glow of a job well done. By his estimation he needed just two more [[Standard week/Legends|standard weeks]] of production and one more shipment of the raw damotite, which was due shortly, so he could contact Count Dooku. Nevertheless, the Sith Lord contacted the Neimoidian first to confront him about his deceitfulness and demanded explanations. Humiliated and exasperated, Durd ordered Barev to reprogram the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] he sent to [[Torbel]], the village in which Kenobi and Skywalker were in hiding, to instead of killing them on site, to capture them alive, as a gift to Dooku. Additionally, as a way to show his worth to the Count - without his permission nor consent - Durd demanded an attack with the bioweapon to be launched in [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]], on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], which killed approximately ten thousand [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] civilians.<ref name="Siege" />

====Battle of Lanteeb====
Watching the aftermath of the [[Attack on Chandrila (Clone Wars)|attack on Chandrila]] on the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], satisfied with the results, Lok Durd started to plan his next attack on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in the subsequent [[Standard day/Legends|days]], as a way to disrupt the [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] market. He also required [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Bant'ena Fhernan|Fhernan]] to refine the [[Damotite bioweapon|weapon’s]] formula - to reduce its weight so the dispersal rate could be faster. On the other hand, the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] he ordered to lay siege to [[Torbel]] remained unsuccessful, thanks to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] who jury-rigged the [[City/Legends|town’s]] [[Deflector shield generator|storm shield]] to deflect the enemy [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. He even stripped his entire compound of battle droids in order to send them to the siege – but it hadn’t done him any good. Ireful, he demanded explanations from [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Barev]] on why the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were still at large as Barev, who was already exhausted with the Neimoidian's temper, said something about not alerting the wrong people to the fact there was a siege, that they couldn’t ship in more droids and [[Heavy weapon|heavier weapons]] for the fear of awkward questions being asked. He told Durd to be patient, promising that the village couldn’t hold much longer.<ref name="Siege" />

Moments later, notwithstanding, the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|ships]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] sent to break [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous’]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] had arrived, putting [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] under siege. After being informed by Barev, General Durd went to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] security complex to see the blockade by himself, as well as to make contact with Grievous, without realizing he left his office door wide open and Dr. Fhernan completely alone with no security whatsoever. Taking advantage of the opportunity, Bant'ena called [[Mata Fhernan]] and found out how she was being hoaxed by the Neimoidian. She told her [[Parent/Legends|mother]] about Bespin, who in turn alerted [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic authorities]]. Full of remorse and debilitated by so much [[Torture/Legends|torture]], Bant’ena became more determined than ever to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] her creation and ruin Durd’s [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]]. Back to the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] with the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], Lok Durd was as waspish as ever, constantly chastising the doctor and yelling at Barev on his [[Comlink/Legends|comm]]. Certain that he could not trust the colonel out of his sight, before heading back to the spaceport to intimidate him, Durd placed an ultimate deadline on Fhernan to have the new formula ready for test until the next morning.<ref name="Siege" />

Amidst the [[Battle of Lanteeb|siege of Lanteeb]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Taria Damsin]] soared past the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist]] blockade of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to land on the surface. She was able to make contact with Dr. Fhernan, revealing the safety of her loved ones and eager to rescue her. Bant’ena, however, insisted on remaining behind in order to “put right her wrongdoings”, setting up the [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosives]] to destroy the samples of the bioweapon, the production complex, the storage unit, as well as the entire compound, [[Death/Legends|sacrificing]] herself in the process as penance for the [[Attack on Chandrila (Clone Wars)|Chandrilan massacre]].<ref name="TERC" /> Returning from the spaceport in his private [[Groundcar/Legends|groundcar]], unleashing his frustration on his personal droid [[KD-77]] by demanding him to drive faster, Lok Durd was baffled by the fact that his authority was defied by Barev, who argued against sending more [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]] to the siege of Torbel, in justification of the spaceport’s security. Nevertheless, less than a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] to reach the facility, a brilliant red-and-white explosion lit up [[Lantibba City|Lantibba’s]] night sky in a false and burning dawn. Terrified by the fact that he escaped death by a matter of [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], Durd ordered KD-77 to drive him back to the spaceport, where he unleashed all his wrath on Barev – who was bewildered to see him alive. After General Durd choked Colonel Barev to death, the Neimoidian contacted General Grievous to stand by to receive his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], so he could escape with the fleeing Confederacy vessels, positive that Grievous would handle the Jedi and the Republic ships, still confident he was important to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], and that he could salvage the disaster that was the destruction of his bioweapon on Lanteeb.<ref name="Siege" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Lok_Durd.png|thumb|right|200px|Lok Durd]]
{{Quote|Uh, sir, there's a Jedi heading right for us.''"<br />"''Then ''blast'' him, you idiot!|Lok Durd chastises an [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]]|audio=LokDurd5.flac|<ref name="DOP" />}}
Lok Durd was a flamboyant,<ref name="DB" /> bossy,<ref name="Complete Season One" /> ruthless,<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> and merciless individual, and was often disliked by his peers for this.<ref name="DB" /> He hoped to be promoted to a higher and more substantial rank within the Separatist Droid Army, which was one of the reasons he developed his defoliator weapon.<ref name="DOP" /> A self-centered Neimoidian, Durd dreamed that with his development of the device, Republic planets would submit to the Confederacy at the mere mention of his name. With a larger salary, he also hoped to spoil his children.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> Durd constantly pontificated and bragged to the battle droids under his command on what the success of his defoliator would bring him.<ref name="Complete Season One" /> In battle, the general preferred to deploy his troops in large head-on rushes. However, he was cowardly, as seen when he chose to escape from the battle after Skywalker had destroyed his defoliator cannon.<ref name="DOP" />

[[File:LokDurd.png|thumb|left|200px|Durd was an arrogant speciesist.]]
A [[Speciesism|Speciesist]] being, Durd believed that Neimoidians were the noblest individuals in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], He also hated humans, thinking that they stink and considered them bigots. He chafed under the need to report to the higher-ranking Human Count Dooku; given all that the Neimoidians had done for the Separatist cause, Durd was offended that Dooku was the public leader of the Confederacy, though underneath he also very fearful of the Count. After arriving on Maridun and selecting the pacifist Lurmen as the defoliator's organic test subjects, Durd lied to Chieftain Kaa, stating that the village was now under the "protection" of the Separatist Alliance, when in fact the colony would be destroyed by his weapon. The Lurmen would be obliterated before anyone else would know of the Neimoidian's massacre, and Durd's "little white lie" would die with them as well.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" />

Durd was very overweight for a Neimoidian,<ref name="DB" /> eating lots of fatty [[Pylat bird/Legends|pylat]] eggs and deep-fried [[chewgrub]]s.<ref name="DOP Decoded" /> As a result of his corpulence, he was a very slow runner.<ref name="DOP" /> Durd wore a Neimoidian mitre<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> with the Separatist insignia set upon it,<ref name="DOP Decoded" /> as well as a tunic of [[Ramordian silk]] adorned with expensive girdles and rank epaulets.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> He was able to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="DOP" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:GeorgeTakei.jpg|thumb|right|220px|George Takei provided the voice of Lok Durd.]]
{{Quote|We decided that going with this sort of really big, heavy, rolly guy with an even bigger hat than Nute Gunray's would just&hellip;would work, would sort of sell that this guy was extremely flamboyant and very bossy and even more gluttonous than your average Neimoidian.|Series Designer [[Kilian Plunkett]], on modeling Lok Durd|<ref name="Complete Season One" />}}
The character of Lok Durd made his first appearance in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]] episode "[[Defenders of Peace]]."<ref name="DOP" /> In the episode, Durd is voiced by [[George Takei]] of [[Memoryalpha:Star Trek|''Star Trek'']] fame. Although his character is captured at the end of the episode, according to interviews with George Takei, Durd was intended to be a recurring villain in the series.<ref name="NA">{{WebCite|url=http://www.newsarama.com/tv/010919-George-Takei.html|text=From 'Trek' to 'Wars': George Takei on Clone Wars|work=Newsarama.com|date=2009-01-19|author=Steve Fritz|archivedate=20090121232020|nolive=1}}</ref> Durd received an entry in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Visual Guide Ultimate Battles'']] sourcebook,<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> and appeared in the 2010 novels ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'' and ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''.<ref name="CWG Siege ">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/news20100127/index.html|text=This Summer: ''Clone Wars Gambit: Siege''}}</ref>

Durd's character was created as an alternative to having the Confederate General Grievous appear multiple times and avoid downplaying his "legend" with multiple Republic victories. Durd's corpulent appearance was built off of the television series production crew's desire to deviate from the pre-existing model for [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], which was similar to that of the Confederate [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]] made for the episode "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]," and helped to further depict his flamboyance and bossiness.<ref name="Complete Season One" />

Ultimately, the character of Durd was not seen in any following episodes of the series, which was canceled in [[2013]].<ref name="New Direction">{{SW|url=news/a-new-direction-for-lucasfilm-animation|text=A New Direction for Lucasfilm Animation}}</ref>
